payout_quote: To qualify for the $300 cash bonus, account must be setup on direct deposit with EECU and you must make qualifying payroll direct deposits totaling $1,500 or more within 90 days of account opening.
steps: Be employed by an approved Independent School District, university, or college in Collin, Dallas, Denton, Ellis, Hood, Johnson, Parker, Rockwall, Tarrant, or Wise County, Texas; become an EECU member
Open an Educators Advantage Checking account ($25 minimum balance required to open)
Set up direct deposit and have qualifying payroll direct deposits totaling $1,500 or more post within 90 days of account opening
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $300 cash bonus is deposited into the account within 90 days of completing the qualifying requirements
catches: Restricted eligibility: only available to members employed by approved ISDs, universities, and colleges in 10 Texas counties (Collin, Dallas, Denton, Ellis, Hood, Johnson, Parker, Rockwall, Tarrant, Wise)
Must be qualifying PAYROLL direct deposits totaling $1,500+ within 90 days - not just any deposits
Bonus paid within 90 days of completing requirements - a long wait on top of the 90-day qualification window
Not available to anyone who has an ownership interest in any existing EECU checking account or had one closed within the last 12 months
EECU may limit each member to one new account-related incentive per calendar year; cannot be combined with other offers
EECU employees, board members, and their family members are not eligible
Bonus is considered income and may be reported to the IRS; recipient is responsible for taxes
Offer availability subject to change at any time without notice
biggest_catch: Only employees of approved schools/universities in 10 Texas counties qualify, and you need $1,500 in payroll direct deposits within 90 days - then wait up to 90 more days for the bonus.
eligibility: EECU members employed by approved ISDs, universities, or colleges in Collin, Dallas, Denton, Ellis, Hood, Johnson, Parker, Rockwall, Tarrant, or Wise County, TX; no ownership in any EECU checking account currently or closed within the last 12 months.
timing: $1,500+ payroll DDs within 90 days of opening; bonus deposited within 90 days of completing requirements.
weasel_words: Offer availability subject to change at any time without notice
Eligibility may be limited based on your account type and ownership role

c1.evidence: EECU (Educational Employees Credit Union) - real operating Texas credit union; $300 Educators Advantage bonus advertised at eecu.org/educators and in the official Truth in Savings Disclosure (revised 6/29/26, effective 7/1/2026).

c2.evidence: Official TIS disclosure footnote 7 states the full $300 bonus terms: eligibility, $1,500 payroll DD in 90 days, good-standing requirement, payout timing, exclusions.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee; $25 minimum balance required to open the account (not a fee).

c4.evidence: Official TIS: 'To qualify for the $300 cash bonus...' with 'The cash bonus will be deposited in your new account within 90 days of completing the qualifying activity requirements.'

s1.note: Approved-educator employer segment in 10 TX counties; no EECU checking ownership now or closed within 12 months; one incentive per member per calendar year; EECU staff/family excluded.

s2.note: Concrete: open Educators Advantage Checking, route $1,500+ payroll DD within 90 days.

s3.note: Bonus deposited within 90 days of completing requirements; account must be open and in good standing.

s4.note: Flat $300 stated; change-without-notice and eligibility-limit disclaimers disclosed.

s5.note: https://www.eecu.org/educators plus the official TIS at eservices.eecu.org (rev. 6/29/26, effective 7/1/2026), content current as of 2026-09-23 (UTC).

s6.note: Steps are concrete: open account as eligible educator, set up payroll DD, wait for payout.

notes: Do not confuse with the older Real Worth Checking $300 variant that Doctor of Credit tags expired; this route covers the current Educators Advantage variant documented in the official TIS disclosure effective 7/1/2026.
payout_value_note: Flat $300 cash bonus stated in the official EECU Truth in Savings disclosure.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($300 flat); time: account opening and payroll-DD setup est. 30-60 min active (qualification spans 90 days, payout up to 90 days later)
